claims.object_text: cell cycle progression and DNA repair
claims.quote: SMC1A is a member of cohesin complex which has essential functions in cell cycle progression and DNA repair.
the lentivirus-mediated RNAi system efficiently decreased the expression level of SMC1A.

claims.object_text: proliferation and colony formation of U251 and U87MG cells
claims.quote: Inhibiting SMC1A expression efficiently (P < 0.001) resulted in inhibiting the proliferation and colony formation of U251 and U87MG cells.
SMC1A silencing led to S cell-cycle arresting.

claims.object_text: siRNA-mediated silencing as a therapeutic tool for glioblastoma
claims.quote: Collectively, these results demonstrated the possibility of siRNA-mediated silencing of SMC1A as a therapeutic tool for the treatment of glioblastoma.
